description: Header file defining array data structures and functions for the lighttpd web server project.

methods.name: array_init
methods.description: Creates and initializes a new array with specified size.

methods.name: array_copy_array
methods.description: Copies data from source array to destination array.

methods.name: array_reset_data_strings
methods.description: Resets data strings in the array.

methods.name: array_insert_unique
methods.description: Inserts a unique entry into the array.

methods.name: array_pop
methods.description: Removes and returns the last element from the array.

methods.name: array_is_vlist
methods.description: Checks if array is a list.

methods.name: array_is_kvany
methods.description: Checks if array is key-value any.

methods.name: array_is_kvarray
methods.description: Checks if array is key-value array.

methods.name: array_is_kvstring
methods.description: Checks if array is key-value string.

methods.name: array_get_element_klen_ext
methods.description: Retrieves element by key with extension.

methods.name: array_get_data_unset
methods.description: Gets data unset element by key.

methods.name: array_extract_element_klen
methods.description: Removes and returns element by key.

methods.name: array_get_int_ptr
methods.description: Gets pointer to integer value by key.

methods.name: array_get_buf_ptr_ext
methods.description: Gets buffer pointer by key with extension.

methods.name: array_insert_value
methods.description: Inserts a value into the array.

methods.name: array_replace
methods.description: Replaces data in array with new entry.

methods.name: array_match_path_or_ext
methods.description: Matches path or extension in array.
